lines.t: Look in these eyes, don’t turn away,
You know the games you’ve learned to play.
You hide your wounds behind a smile,
Call it “life” and “just a trial.”You blame the past for what you choose,
Wear every scar like some excuse.
But when the midnight strips you bare,
You feel a gaze inside your prayer.
So, soul of mine, stop holding back,
Stop painting white on all this black.
There is a Fire behind your shame,
Burning gently, calling your name.
Stand and face the mirror now,
See the enemy somehow
Looks a lot like you, but don’t lose heart.
Raise that trembling seed of faith,
Trust the Love that does not break,
Lay your pretense down and play your part.
On the smallest thread of trust,
Step into the Light you fear so much.
You grew up inside broken walls,
Heard twisted echoes in those halls.
Words like daggers, cold and deep,
Taught your heart it’s safer asleep.You called that ruin “who I am,”
Built your theology of blame.
But there’s a Voice beneath the pain,
Saying, “You are more than this chain.”
So, soul of mine, name every wound,
But don’t let them define your tomb.
There is a Hand that knows your grief,
And still it calls for your belief.
Stand and face the mirror now,
See the enemy somehow
Is the way you hide and shift the blame.
Lift that flicker of belief,
Trust the One beneath your grief,
Let Him speak the truth into your shame.
On the smallest thread of trust,
Step into the Light you fear so much.
You’ve worn religion like a cloak,
Spoke all the words good people quote.
Confessed the sins that feel “out loud,”
Kept secret thoughts beneath the shroud.You tell yourself, “I’m doing fine,”
While envy prowls between the lines.
You preach forgiveness, nurse the grudge,
Play both the victim and the judge.
So, soul of mine, drop every mask,
No more clever, holy acts.
There is an Eye that sees within,
Dividing wound from chosen sin.
Stand and face the mirror now,
See the enemy somehow
Is the heart that loves its chains and cries.
Take that fragile, shaking trust,
Lay your secrets in the dust,
Let a jealous Love consume your lies.
On the smallest thread of trust,
Step into the Light you fear so much.
Drag it to the open floor.They broke your heart, you bear those scars,
They left their fingerprints in jars.
But you chose darkness, stroke by stroke,
You fed the fire, you breathed the smoke.Heal the child they tried to break,
Judge the man you chose to make.
Let both stand beneath His gaze,
Let one be mended, one be changed.
If all you have is just a spark,
Hold it up into the dark.
If all your courage is one breath,
Let it testify to death.Soul of mine, this holy fear
Is not your chains, it draws you near.
There is a Lion at the door,
But His roar is love that calls for more.[Soft Refrain – Spoken/Sung]
“Without this faith, you cannot please,
Without this trust, you will not see.
Believe He is, believe He hears,
Believe He gathers all your tears.”
You’ve lived half‑truths to stay alive,
Let hidden illness steer your drive.
Called your anger “righteous flame,”
Called your lust by softer names.But there’s a Law inside your chest,
A quiet knowing of what’s best.
You feel the pulling in your bones,
To drop your pride and come back home.
So, soul of mine, be fully known,
Let every inward part be shown.
There is a Righteous, burning Heart,
Longing to set you clean apart.
Stand and face the mirror now,
Let the tears come pouring out,
Grace is waiting where you fall apart.
Cling to that small seed of faith,
Trust the Love that does not break,
Place your shattered truth into His heart.
On the smallest thread of trust,
Step into the Light you fear so much.
No more hiding, no more flight,
Walk straight into holy Light.
Let His fire search every room,
Burn the lies, but spare the bloom.This is not a gentle game,
This is mercy in a flame.
Jealous kindness, fierce and pure,
Breaking what you can’t endure.
Stand and face the mirror now,
Hear your own soul make this vow,
“I will not retreat into my schemes.
On this trembling, tiniest faith,
I will trust the One who saves,
